turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The running shop wants to do a gait analysis before selling me shoes. Is that worth it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can help, especially if you've had injuries. They watch how your foot lands and suggest shoes that suit you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or is it just a way to sell expensive shoes?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sometimes it's a bit of both. Comfort is the most important thing, research says choosing what feels best works well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I should just try them on?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, try several pairs and jog around in them if the shop lets you. Go in the afternoon, when your feet are a little bigger.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Feet swell a bit during the day, and even more when you run. Leave about a thumb's width at the toe.
